name: Phone notifications
author: spacewaffle42
description: Notifications from your phone: a short pop-up over the playlist, and the last few on a screen. Your phone sends them through ntfy.sh.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Topic name
fields.note: The private name your phone sends to. Leave it empty and one is made for you, shown once in the line below. Letters, numbers, - and _ (up to 64).

fields.name: token
fields.label: Access token (optional)
fields.note: Only if you reserved the topic on an ntfy.sh account: a token from there (tk_...).

fields.name: show
fields.label: On the panel, show
fields.note: For pop-ups and screens. To keep the text off ntfy.sh too, leave it out on the phone (see the setup steps).

fields.name: gap
fields.label: Pop-ups at most every
fields.note: Any that come in between wait, then pop up together ("3 new").

fields.name: quiet_hours
fields.label: Quiet hours
fields.note: No pop-ups then, like 21:30-07:00 (empty: none). Never in the sleep hours either. They still go in the list.

fields.name: keep
fields.label: Keep the last
fields.note: How many the screens list. Each is forgotten a day after it came.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Sum up after quiet hours
fields.note: One pop-up when quiet or sleep hours end, saying how many came ("5 while quiet"). Off: they're just in the list.

table.title: Kinds, and the tag the phone sends
rows: Deliveries: a courier's app or texts
Anything else: tag it with the app's name

settings.note: Your phone sends to ntfy.sh, a free public relay, and this module listens there. Treat the topic name like a password: anyone who has it can read what you send and post onto your panel. The list is kept only on this Matrix, never in a backup. Pop-ups never come in the sleep hours.
